brief.headline: Push laminate price from ₹1067.36/KG down toward ₹250/KG — we're paying 326.9% more than our best vendor and well above the fair market band of ₹205–305/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Ask Huhtamaki to match or beat ₹250/KG for laminate — the price Silk Polypack gives us and the top of the fair market band.
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG (our best price) or below; current price is ₹1067.36/KG
priceAsk.basis: We're paying a 326.9% gap over our best vendor. Market data shows pharma/ORS sachet laminate asks run ₹205–305/kg, with ₹250/kg typical and judged market-fair at the top of that band. BOPET film import unit value is 171.60 ₹/kg. Closing this gap saves us ₹58850 a year on tiny spend — so every rupee counts.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days after receipt — we're already on standard terms and they're healthy enough that faster payment buys us nothing.

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is solid: ₹2755.75 Cr revenue, keeps about ₹5 of every ₹100 (4.7% profit), and carries almost no debt (0.11x). Health score is C (58/100) — mid-range, no red flags. But we're invisible to them: our ₹76850 spend is 0.00% of their sales, so on our own we have zero pull. They are growing fast — 23.1% a year — which means they want new orders. Our play is to commit more volume or a longer contract in return for the price cut, and to line up UFLEX or Constantia Parikh as a credible second source so Huhtamaki knows we can walk.

evidence.point: We pay ₹1067.36/KG; our best vendor (Silk Polypack) charges ₹250.00/KG — a 326.9% gap
Market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg, verdict MARKET-FAIR at the top of the band
BOPET film (the substrate) imports at 171.60 ₹/kg — well below what we're paying for finished laminate
Closing the price gap saves us ₹58850 a year
We're 0.00% of their ₹2755.75 Cr revenue — tiny customer with no natural leverage
They're growing sales 23.1% a year, so they want volume commitments

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed giant (₹16492.00 Cr revenue) that makes both film and converts laminates — can second-source at scale; health C (46/100).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specializes in pharma blister and sachet laminates (₹222.04 Cr revenue) — strong fit for our ORS sachets; health D (31/100).

risks: We're only ₹76850 spend — alone we're too small to matter, so bundle more SKUs or commit multi-year volume to get their attention.
Huhtamaki is a converter, not a film maker — their price includes a conversion margin; benchmark hard to Silk Polypack (also a converter at ₹250/KG) and ask why Huhtamaki is 4× higher.
If they won't move much, qualify UFLEX or Constantia Parikh fast and split the business — competition will force the price down over time.
Don't squeeze so hard that we push this small spend onto a weaker second source and create a new quality or delivery risk — keep Huhtamaki in the mix at a fair price.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but at ₹1067/kg we're paying more than four times what another converter charges us for the same laminate — help us understand the gap and let's find a path to ₹250/kg so we can grow the business together.
